title: HDL Cholesterol
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: HDL, often called good cholesterol, helps remove LDL from the blood. It is reported as part of a cholesterol panel.
low: MedlinePlus describes low HDL as under 40 mg/dL in men and under 50 mg/dL in women.
high: A higher HDL may help lower the risk of heart attack or stroke.
notes: Fasting for 9 to 12 hours may be needed before the test. Talk to a provider before making major changes to diet or exercise.
